# ANXA Infra · Project 49

> ANXA Infra (anxainfra.com) is a home design and construction company in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Its collection, Project 49, designs and builds 49 one-of-a-kind, architect-designed independent homes and villas for families on their own land, across seven design philosophies.

## Key facts
- Company: ANXA Infra (also written Anxa Infra, anxainfra)
- Collection: Project 49 — 49 homes, 7 philosophies, no two homes alike
- Service: custom residential design and construction on the client's own plot (design and build)
- Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India
- Areas served: Kokapet, Narsingi, Gandipet, Tellapur, Moinabad, the Financial District, Jubilee Hills and Banjara Hills
- People: envisioned by architect Saketh Bharadwaj; brought to life by Divya Dacharla
- Contact: WhatsApp Business +91 81792 59334; enquiry form at https://www.anxainfra.com/#conversation
- Languages: English, Telugu, Hindi

## The seven design philosophies
- Light: Rooms are placed and openings cut so daylight moves through the house from morning to evening, and shade arrives where the afternoon is hottest.
- Air: Cross-ventilation, courtyards and deep openings let the breeze pass through every room, so the house stays cool the way Deccan homes always have.
- Art: Gallery walls, murals and space for sculpture are designed into the house from the first drawing, not hung on it afterwards.
- Roots: Carved stone, the threshold and the courtyard: houses made by hand, in the building language of the Deccan.
- Earth: Rammed-earth walls, natural stone and trees growing inside the house. Materials taken from the land and built back into it.
- Silence: Thick walls, water and quiet courts. Each house is planned so the noise of the city stops at the door.
- Future: Smart glass, hidden screens and a kitchen that grows food, built in so technology is there when you need it and gone when you do not.

## Process
1. Walk the land together (light, trees, slope).
2. Choose a philosophy.
3. The home is designed exclusively for that land and family, built, and handed over.
